instruction: Look at library_part.step in SolidCAM. Manually define the required tools in the SolidCAM Tool Table, then create Face, Drill, and Profile operations on library_part.step. Tool definitions to create manually in SolidCAM Tool Table: T1 face/end mill, T2 drill, T3 profile end mill, and T4 finishing tool matching the required operations. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-12.nc. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
source: SolidCAM Professor 包含 Adding a New Machine & Material to the iDatabase、Creating Holders & Shaped Tools 等教学条目：https://solidcam.com/professor-video/ (SolidCAM)
